title: Kissed Caramel Middle Eastern Kabocha Tagine
description: A jammy and aromatic Middle Eastern dish featuring caramelized kabocha, perfect for adventurous eaters, and gluten-free friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, stirring occasionally.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cubed kabocha squash and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the ground cumin, ground coriander, and cinnamon, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the honey, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the tagine or Dutch oven, and simmer the mixture for 20 minutes, or until the kabocha is tender.
Remove the tagine or Dutch oven from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the kissed caramel Middle Eastern kabocha tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
